## Behavior
- `getUser()` error returned (UstGezinmeCubugu.tsx:49) → `oturumAcik=false`, `kimlikHatasi="oturumDogrulanamadi"`.
- Promise rejection (UstGezinmeCubugu.tsx:57) → same fail-closed status (no longer a silent signed-out look).
- Successful `getUser()` → real user state + `setKimlikHatasi(null)`.
- Auth event with a present session → real user state + clears only the verification status (UstGezinmeCubugu.tsx:41); a session-less event (e.g. `INITIAL_SESSION` signed-out, possibly emitted late) cannot wipe a genuine failure notice.
- Config-init `catch` still → `"yapilandirilamadi"`; sign-out success/failure untouched.
- Status paragraph keeps `role="status" aria-live="polite"` with `aria-hidden` icon; message map is `Record<NonNullable<...>, string>` so all 3 variants are exhaustively localized (exhaustive — a new variant fails type-check).
- No fake client, no credentials, no dependency/schema/env change, no `any`, no hardcoded user-facing strings.

## Evidence gap — must be run by Chief
This session had **no shell/command tool** (only file read/write/edit), so I could not run `npm run cakisma-kontrol`, `npm run kalite`, or `npm run build`. **I do not claim the quality gate passed.** Type-safety claims are static reasoning only: `UserResponse = RequestResultSafeDestructure<{user: User}>` (node_modules/@supabase/auth-js/dist/module/lib/types.d.ts:280) narrows on `error`, so `data.user` stays valid in the success branch. Please run:
```powershell
npm run cakisma-kontrol -- --agent opencode bilesenler/genel/UstGezinmeCubugu.tsx i18n/mesajlar/tr.json i18n/mesajlar/en.json i18n/mesajlar/ru.json i18n/mesajlar/he.json
npm run kalite
```
then the isolated-worktree build per AGENTS.md §7.5.

## Risk note (for Cline)
A failed `getUser()` leaves the banner until a *session-bearing* auth event or a successful re-verification. If verification fails while a valid session exists, the user sees a transient warning alongside a signed-out header until the next auth event — intentional fail-closed, but worth Cline's review.
